ownership.core_operator: shared across R visits at each core position
ownership.core_ln2_and_point_ffn: shared across R visits as part of the complete core block
ownership.head: last suffix only

ownership.core_operators: C modules; each owns ln_1 and LinearNO operator and is shared across R
ownership.core_point_ffns: C*R modules; each owns ln_2 and native point MLP
ownership.latent_ffns: 0 for round_specific; C for round_specific_latent, one per core position shared across R
ownership.head: last suffix only

latent_contract.location: after K^T V and before Q readout

initialization.common_tree: Construct and release-initialize common v2 modules in identical order, then draw placeholder.
initialization.round_ffns: Distinct parameters and independent draws for every (core position, round).
initialization.latent: Construct and initialize after common state inside fork_rng with a recorded derived feature seed; zero W2 last.

stages.LF1: Versioned pure config/schema/metadata and matrix; no torch model or production route.
stages.LF2: Round-specific point FFN primitive and synthetic core with all three residuals.
stages.LF3: Latent context FFN and six-variant context adapter with independent oracle.
stages.LF4: Full synthetic Standard/Air/Car v2 wrappers, fair initialization and strict checkpoint closure.
stages.LF6: AirfRANS and ShapeNet-Car production task integrations.
stages.LF7: Launchers, cost tools, final no-data matrix, regressions and delivery.
